comparison.objective: Roll a block on loose rollers into a zone, repeatedly relocating a roller; candidate commissions a shock absorber through adjustment and dynamic testing.
comparison.physical_skill: PR uses bimanual rolling, support transfer, and object transport; candidate uses recessed hex-key engagement, counterholding, fine collar rotation, torque-limited locking, and response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the block in a marked zone after roller handling; candidate requires two ≥0.85 J cycles within velocity/stroke limits, without bottoming, hard-stop contact, rebound, overload, or lock drift.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanisms and outcomes differ meaningfully. PR has no spec versions and does not state numeric placement tolerances or roller-loss/damage criteria, but those omissions do not make this unrelated transport objective a plausible duplicate.
